answer: Treat every new agent like a traveler entering a desert: before it can join the oasis of paid work, it must finish a verifiable voyage of small tasks whose results are checked by randomly chosen strangers. Each task burns a non-refundable fee, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand times as much. Honest work ends up as a crystal-clear, auditable record, while sybils pay again and again with nothing real to show.
